config.script:
import re
	# create the array for the cms assets
	
	scope = ["QC", "RTG"]
	root_path = "[Aggregator]asset"
	scope_filters = [{"name": "*{}*".format(asset_type)} for asset_type in scope]
	tags = []
	for f in scope_filters:
	    tags.extend(system.tag.browse(root_path, f))
	    
	assets = []
	for tag_folder in tags:
		path = tag_folder.get("fullPath")
		tags = system.tag.browse(path)
		assets.extend([str(tag["name"]) for tag in tags])
	
	def get_asset_prefix(tag_name):
	    # Busca una o más letras al inicio de la cadena
	    match = re.match(r'^([A-Za-z]+)', tag_name)
	    return match.group(1) if match else None
		
	# create dataset of assets
	headers = ["asset_type", "asset_name"]
	rows = [[get_asset_prefix(asset), asset] for asset in assets]
	
	self.view.custom.assets = system.dataset.toDataset(headers, rows)

# get data for the row (asset setected) ans write in custom var, for diagnostics
	self.view.custom.selectedRow = self.props.selection.data[0]
	# create the params dict from table to pass to funcion query caller
	params = self.props.selection.data[0]
	# get the data for the asset selected
	# activate bar for show activity to user when click over row
	self.view.custom.activate_bar = True
	# retrieve rmcs for asset selected from db
	data = dfo_rcms.dev1.get_config(params)
	# write in custom var for diagnostics
	self.view.custom.config_data = data
	# deactivate activity bar (only for visualization)
	self.view.custom.activate_bar = False

self.view.custom.activate_bar = True
	# write the form data in a param to diagnostics
	params = self.props.data
	self.view.custom.params = params
	
	# pass the params to the url generator to get the url string
	url = dfo_rcms.dev1.get_url("dfov1", params)
	self.view.custom.url = url
	
	# selected asset
	#selected = self.view
	
	# store config, get the state of the query 1 = new inserted, 0 = modified
	state = dfo_rcms.dev1.store_config(dict(params))
	self.view.custom.activate_bar = False
	
	popup_view = "popups/notify_result"
	# defaul for new register
	popup_parmas = {"icon_path": "material/done", "header":"Successfully Register", "text_feedback": "Result: {}".format(state)}
	if state == 0:
		# for same data
		icon_color = "#00D900"
		popup_parmas.update({"icon_path": "material/announcement", "header": "No changes recorded", "icon_color": icon_color})
	elif state == 1:
		# modification
		icon_color = "#00D900"
		popup_parmas.update({"icon_path": "material/done", "header": "Successful update", "icon_color": icon_color})
	elif state == 2:
		icon_color = "#FF8C00"
		popup_parmas.update({"icon_path": "material/done_all", "header": "Successful update", "icon_color": icon_color})
	system.perspective.openPopup("register_result", popup_view, params = popup_parmas, showCloseIcon = True, resizable = False, draggable= False)
